game.name: Blur
game.desc: Blur mistura corridas e combate motorizado. O jogo permite-te controlar modelos de carros reais modificados para o sistema de corridas. Cada modelo é caracterizado por cinco critérios: velocidade máxima, aceleração, aderência, controlo e saúde (resistência ao choque). As corridas desenrolam-se em vários ambientes urbanos ou semi-urbanos (cidade, docas, pistas de aeroporto, etc.). Dependendo do modo de jogo, podes correr sozinho ou em estafetas. Utilizando bónus, fazendo acrobacias e dominando, podes ganhar "pontos de fã", que te dão acesso a novos modelos e ajudam a tua carreira.

game.name: Broforce
game.desc: Broforce é um jogo 2D que parodia os heróis e os mundos dos filmes de ação dos anos 80 e 90. Broforce consiste em navegar por níveis amplamente destrutíveis para chegar a um helicóptero, normalmente depois de matar um chefe ou um demónio vestido de homem de negócios. O jogador controla uma personagem selecionada aleatoriamente entre as disponíveis. Ao longo do nível, o jogador pode libertar prisioneiros, o que lhe permite ressuscitar um aliado ou, se necessário, recuperar uma vida e mudar a personagem que está a controlar. Cada personagem é jogada à sua maneira, com variações de velocidade de movimento, salto, fogo principal, fogo secundário e ataque corpo a corpo.

game.name: Castle Crashers
game.desc: Castle Crashers is a side-scrolling beat-em-up involving knights who need to retrieve a stolen gem and many princesses for their king. Using a hand-drawn style as seen in Alien Hominid, players can initially choose from four different knights with separate fighting styles, along with the alien from Alien Hominid. Other characters (20 in total) are later unlocked or discovered through the course of the game. Although the game can be played by a single player, up to four player can fight together on the same screen in the cooperative game modes, both offline and online. Some elements in the levels can only be activated or interacted with by specific characters.

game.name: Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse
game.desc:
Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse, é um remake do jogo Genesis de mesmo nome. Mickey e Minnie estão fora para um piquenique quando Minnie é sequestrada pela bruxa Mizrabel. Agora Mickey tem que viajar por cinco mundos para resgatá-la.
Este é um jogo de plataforma side-scrolling em que Mickey salta sobre obstáculos e evita inimigos para permanecer vivo. Embora a maior parte do jogo seja passada em uma visão 2D tradicional, para algumas seções (por exemplo, chefes ou certos quebra-cabeças) ele muda para um ambiente 3D. Mickey pode derrotar inimigos saltando sobre eles ou usando projéteis que pega no caminho. Os níveis são vagamente baseados nos antigos, mas apresentam várias diferenças de design de nível, novos setpieces e lutas de chefe aprimoradas. Além de vencer o jogo, os jogadores podem explorar os níveis em busca de segredos (desbloquear roupas adicionais) ou enfrentar os níveis no modo de ataque temporal.
game.genre: Ação-Plataforma / Corre e Pula com rolagem-Plataforma

Inspired by the classics from the “golden age”, and with an art style that mimics the aesthetic from the 90's arcade gems, this game pays homage to all classic gameplay features that makes this genre one of the best from its time!Details Genre: Classic 2D side-scroller beat’em up / brawler. Number of players: From one up to three players local co-op.

game.name: Mayhem Brawler
game.desc:
TO PROTECT AND SERVE While answering a routine call on a patrol, Dolphin, Star, and Trouble -the most popular officers of the super-powered law enforcement agency, Stronghold- find themselves in a sequence of events that will alter the fate of the entire city.
EXCESSIVE FORCE Let’s get one thing straight; if you ever think that a day in the life of a super-powered law enforcer is easy, you couldn’t be more wrong, as there are greater threats than street gangs in urban fantasy-themed Mayhem Brawler. Using your arsenal of combos and special abilities, you and your co-op teammates should make life miserable for those super-powered criminals, fend yourself from the fury of werewolves, resist the hexes of street wizards and confront the megacorp led by vampire houses that enforce their goons to do their dirty deeds.

Mother Russia Bleeds
game.desc: Mother Russia Bleeds é um Beat'em Up ultra violento, com um estilo gráfico único e uma brutalidade incrível, jogável até 4 jogadores em cooperação. Situado numa URSS alternativa, seguimos a história de combatentes subterrâneos presos pelos Bratva, e usados como cobaias em experiências com novas drogas. Sofrendo os efeitos do vício, devem superar o seu cativeiro e enfrentar a opressão de um governo corrupto. Lute sozinho ou ao lado dos seus amigos num modo de história único, ou assuma a arena num modo de sobrevivência impiedoso.

game.name: Rayman Origins
game.desc: During what appears to be a normal day, Rayman and his friends are chilling out on a giant tree in their homeland, the Glade of Dreams. Their constant snoring however disturbs an old granny from a land located in the depths below, the Land of the Livid Dead. Determined to put an end to the never ending noises she sends an army of evil creatures across the land, capturing all Electoons and Nymphs that populate the world in the process. As Rayman and his friends are captured from the creatures, they must flee their prison and attempt to bring order back to the Glade of Dreams before it's too late.

game.name: Shank 2
game.desc: Shank 2 is the sequel to Shank and just like the first game it is a 2D side-scrolling platformer based around fighting multiple enemies at once, combined with jumping and climbing platform elements. After the events of the first game Shank travels to a country with a South American setting in search of Linda, the woman who raised him at the orphanage. The country is ruled by Magnus, who was elected after promising to deal with the illegal cartels. He has a weak heart however and Linda appears to be the only one who can provide him with a viable transplant, so he kidnaps her. The events start when Shank's bus is halted and due to his fights against Magnus's minions the locals think he joins their rebellion.

game.name: Skullgirls
game.desc:
Skullgirls is a 2D fighting game with a cast of eight playable fighters. In addition to the random arcade mode and story modes, the game also includes local play, tournament play, ranked match quick play and lobby play, the latter of the two taking place in online multiplayer.
In arcade play or multiplayer, the player can select whether they want a team of two fighters with their health split in half, a team of three fighters with their health split in third, or one single powerful fighter.

game.name: Street Fighter X Tekken
game.desc: The ultimate match-up you never thought possible is here! STREET FIGHTER and TEKKEN, fighting's biggest brands, finally clash in the ultimate tag-team battle! Featuring your favorite warriors from each franchise and an all-new gameplay and control system designed for fans of both series, casual and veteran players can enjoy the biggest event to ever happen in fighting games. The unimaginable has begun - Street Fighter X Tekken!
